As Esperion Therapeutics (ESPR) Shares Rose, Shareholder Sabby Management Boosted Position; Bbr Partners Decreased Its Albemarle (ALB) Position as Stock Value Declined
May 24, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Bbr Partners Llc decreased its stake in Albemarle Corp (ALB) by 40.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bbr Partners Llc sold 6,587 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,731 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.24M, down from 16,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Albemarle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.63% or $4.7175 $97.1225. About 976,968 shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 10.68% since May 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.23% the S&P500.
Hal Mintz increased its stake in Esperion Therapeutics Inc (ESPR) by 70.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sabby Management Llc bought 58,828 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.41% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Hal Mintz held 142,185 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.36 million, up from 83,357 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sabby Management Llc who had been investing in Esperion Therapeutics Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.50% or $0.19 $38.51. About 182,583 shares traded. Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:ESPR) has risen 89.86% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 78.31% the S&P500.
Sabby Management Llc, which manages about $835.79 million and $1.08B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ionis Pharmaceuticals Inc (Put) by 382 shares to 1,230 shares, valued at $6.19 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Merck & Co Inc (Put) by 1,527 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2,652 shares, and cut its stake in Oncobiologics Inc.
